items.summary: Bringing code onto the canvas gives teams a shared space to compare working prototypes side by side, refine a direction, and collaborate on ideas with teammates. This workflow shows how a designer uses code layers and the Figma agent to explore a new feature.

items.title: How Figma manages sandboxes at scale
items.summary: Figma’s AI products require tens of thousands of sandboxes to run untrusted code safely. That’s why we built Nimbus: a platform that makes sandboxes fast, reliable, and easy for Figma product teams and operators to manage.

items.title: How we’re training a Figma-fluent editing model
items.summary: We’ve increasingly seen that specialized post-training can compete with frontier models. Here, we’re sharing the research behind how we’re translating that to design editing workflows.

items.title: How to put your design system to work with the Figma agent
items.summary: Your design system can help the Figma agent understand the principles and guidelines that define your product. Here’s how to make that context useful to the agent.

items.title: Build by design: New workflows for new ways of building

items.title: Introducing Specs: Markdown as a medium

items.title: 3 ways product designers use the Figma agent for craft, speed, and creative expression

items.title: Workflow lab: Staying in the flow with Figma’s agent
items.summary: Knowing what work to hand to an agent is a skill of its own. This workflow shows how a designer shapes a new temporary-access feature while the Figma agent handles the library updates, crit feedback, and a first draft of a design system spec.

items.title: How to lighten design system upkeep with the Figma agent
items.summary: Figma’s agent can take on repetitive work across your design system, from maintaining your library to automating how designs adhere to it. Here, we share a few ways to put the Figma agent to work.

items.title: What it takes to build great products now

items.title: Getting started with Web Answer on Amazon Bedrock AgentCore
items.summary: Web Answer on Amazon Bedrock AgentCore returns a synthesized, source-cited answer to a natural-language question in a single tool call, with no search, retrieve, synthesize, and citation pipeline to build. Learn how it works and how to add it to an AgentCore Gateway and call it from an agent.

items.title: How Amazon Marketplace evaluates content quality with Amazon SageMaker AI
items.summary: Learn how Amazon Marketplace evaluates A+ Content quality at scale on Amazon SageMaker AI by rendering each product page as a single snapshot, scoring it with a vision-language model fused with OCR readability signals in a CatBoost classifier, and using SHAP to turn each decision into prioritized, actionable recommendations for selling partners.

items.title: Use decision models with Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Evaluations
items.summary: Some agent-evaluation questions are narrow and repeatable, and decision models answer exactly that kind of question. This post shows how to connect two decision models, Jev and Strands Decider, to Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Evaluations through code-based evaluators, and how to validate a decision-model check before you gate a release on it.

items.title: Smart Approvals in Amazon Quick: Human oversight where it matters
items.summary: Smart Approvals in Amazon Quick reviews eligible agent actions within your existing controls, reducing unnecessary approval prompts while keeping consequential decisions with a person. See how policy sets the boundary, how a classifier reviews actions, and how AWS CloudTrail and Amazon CloudWatch Logs support audit.

items.title: Four layers of context engineering for production AI agents: How Deep Insight applies them in working code
items.summary: In production AI agents, context management is the real bottleneck. This post presents a four-layer context engineering framework (architecture, prompts, file-based tools, and verification agents), implemented in working code from Deep Insight, an open source multi-agent data analysis solution on the Strands Agents SDK and Amazon Bedrock AgentCore.

items.title: How Indegene is modernizing and scaling enterprise data quality in life sciences
items.summary: This post explores how Indegene built a production-grade, LLM-powered Data Quality Agent in its NEXT Unified Data Platform on AWS. The agent generates context-aware data quality rules, validates them, and produces ready-to-run SQL and Python under human-in-the-loop governance, helping life sciences organizations scale enterprise data quality.

items.title: How U Mobile built agentic telco operations with Amazon Bedrock AgentCore
items.summary: U Mobile, Malaysia’s newest 5G network provider, built AiDaH, an agentic AI operations platform on Amazon Bedrock AgentCore that moves beyond AI assistance to autonomous action across telco operations. Nine months after production launch, AiDaH handles over 150 operational scenarios across six divisions, cutting trouble tickets by up to 84.5%.

items.title: Bring structured and unstructured data together with Amazon Quick
items.summary: Amazon Quick brings structured and unstructured data together in one experience. In this post, you connect Amazon S3 as a knowledge base, enrich a dataset, build a Space, and create a custom chat agent that answers business questions across both data types through a single conversational interface.

items.title: ServiceNow on-behalf-of token exchange with Bedrock AgentCore Gateway
items.summary: Learn how to configure Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Gateway for an on-behalf-of (OBO) token exchange with Microsoft Entra ID, so an AI agent can call the ServiceNow REST API while preserving the calling user’s identity. AgentCore Gateway performs the exchange natively, with no interceptor Lambda or custom code.

items.title: How Gen Digital built Norton Revamp’s AI-curated News Engine with Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Web Search
items.summary: Gen Digital built Norton Revamp, a generative AI-powered professional reputation management platform, with an AI-curated News Engine grounded by Web Search on Amazon Bedrock AgentCore. See how the Gen team delivers real-time, cited content suggestions, goal setting, and news feeds with zero data egress and Norton-grade privacy.
